sync.title: Offline sync
sync.intro: Field attendance and project assignments can wait on this device. These rules decide what happens when they meet the server.
sync.synced: Queued changes are on the server.
sync.syncedWithConflicts: Sync finished. Some changes need a decision.
sync.assignmentQueued: The project link is queued on this device.
sync.needsReview: The server kept its copy and opened a conflict.
sync.rule1: Attendance is identified by session and beneficiary. The same status is ignored.
sync.rule2: If nobody else changed the row, the field mark wins.
sync.rule3: A mark taken during the session (from 15 minutes before the start until 2 hours after the end) replaces a server edit made outside that window.
sync.rule4: A field mark outside the session window never overwrites the server.
sync.rule5: If both marks were taken during the session and they disagree, the server value stays until someone chooses.
sync.rule6: Project assignment never copies a person. A new link is created, an existing active link is left as-is, and a withdraw is blocked when server notes changed or the device has no base version.
sync.pagesReady: Pages are ready for offline use.
sync.pagesIncomplete: Some pages could not be saved. Stay online and reopen the page to complete preparation.

centers.intro: Manage centers, their projects, beneficiaries and managers
centers.transferHelp: Changing a beneficiary’s center requires a transfer request and administrator approval.
centers.managerHelp: Create the center first, then create a Center manager account in Staff and select its center.
centers.approvalHelp: The beneficiary remains at the current center until the administrator approves. All previous records are retained.
centers.reviewOnline: Transfer review requires an internet connection to verify the current center.
centers.assignBeforeTransfer: This beneficiary has no center. Assign the current center in their record before requesting a transfer.
